integrity: Proof gives an eight-element upper bound and an exact coefficient criterion; special examples are checked by rational symbolic polynomial algebra. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Embedded projective automorphism classification only for integral even sextics with precisely five ordinary geometric nodes in the signed rectangular configuration; abstract automorphisms and three-node degenerations are not classified. Both explicit Howe examples are over the complex numbers.
title: Full projective symmetry dichotomy for five-nodal even sextics
